dContract.scope: D contract acceptance does not mean Adapter implementation acceptance

rules.validationPoint: adapter before GraphDigestV2 input construction; pure module repeats structural path checks
rules.hostResponsibility: host may bind registry/project identity later, but cannot repair a path mismatch
rules.prohibitedShortcut: node label, relation id, or string similarity is not byte-source proof

trustedEvidence: strict UTF-8 decoded immutable source bytes
rules.validationPoint: adapter uses fatal UTF-8 decoding, builds UTF-16 code-unit to UTF-8 byte boundaries, and verifies token start/span
rules.hostResponsibility: none; host observation cannot change a static source span
rules.prohibitedShortcut: replacement decoding, numeric equality alone, or span omission is insufficient

rules.claim: tokenUse.byteOffset == Relation.sourceUse.byteOffset == mapping.sourceUse.byteOffset; location.byteOffset is optional but equal when present
trustedEvidence: UTF-16 code-unit start to byte-boundary recomputation
rules.validationPoint: adapter source snapshot validator; no LF/CRLF, NFC/NFD, case, or path normalization
rules.optionalRule: if tokenUse.location.byteOffset exists, it must equal all required byte offsets
rules.hostResponsibility: none; platform-specific offset drift is a source snapshot failure, not host proof
rules.prohibitedShortcut: charOffset equality, relation id equality, or synthetic location.byteOffset cannot substitute for required byte proof
rules.adoptedOption: D SM-03 option 2; do not add location.byteOffset to canonical GraphDigest input

rules.claim: mapping.sourceAnchorRelationId selects one reads/source-proven edge from a file node to the exact token-use node
rules.validationPoint: adapter relation index and immutable source path check; pure module validates endpoint/kind/certainty/equality
rules.hostResponsibility: host can attest analyzer build, not invent an absent anchor
rules.prohibitedShortcut: node names and endpoint strings alone do not prove an anchor

strictUtf8AndCodeUnit.decoder: fatal UTF-8 decoder; invalid byte sequence is not replaced
strictUtf8AndCodeUnit.validUfffd: accept U+FFFD encoded as EF BF BD; one UTF-16 code-unit and three UTF-8 bytes
strictUtf8AndCodeUnit.surrogateBoundary: a code-unit offset inside a surrogate pair is mappingDecision=mapping-rejected
strictUtf8AndCodeUnit.span: verify token start and span in decoded text and original byte snapshot
strictUtf8AndCodeUnit.normalization: none: no LF/CRLF, NFC/NFD, case, or path normalization

coverage.cardinality: exactly one mapping and one unique source-proven reads anchor per token-use
coverage.zeroTokenUse: sourceMappings must be empty and coverage is complete

states.rejected: malformed structure or input; no digest
states.unavailable: structure valid but snapshot, UTF-8, registry, TOCTOU, required byte proof, or full mapping coverage is missing; no trusted adapter result
states.availableContentOnly: all ten fields, all token-use mappings, immutable bytes, and registry binding validate; pure content digest only

statusRules.missingMapping: preserve graph and unresolved diagnostics, return unavailable; do not emit trusted mapping
statusRules.duplicateMapping: reject the mapping set; one sourceRef, graphNodeId, and anchor cannot be mapped twice
statusRules.conflictingMapping: reject; differing path/offset/anchor/sourceIdentity is not merged
statusRules.untrustedProjectId: unavailable even when pure content validation succeeds

digestBoundary.locationByteOffset: optional producer metadata; never synthesized into canonical GraphDigest input
digestBoundary.adapter: snapshot, offsets, coverage, registry, and TOCTOU validation
